name: Letterpress
idea: Editorial and unhurried, like a good magazine. Serif type on warm paper, a drawn map, and profiles you read like a letter.

name: After dark
idea: A sharp modern app that sits comfortably next to anything else on your phone. Dark and glowing, photo-led, with one ember-bright color.

name: Big sky
idea: Bright, open and a little cheeky, like the name. Giant friendly type, bobbing stickers and bold blocks of color.
